title: Prestige at 70 & new titles
changes: Prestige now requires level 70 (was stage 50) — more runway before each rebirth
3 new prestige titles: the Paragon (10 prestiges), the Demigod (25), the Worldforger (50)

title: ♾️ Infinite gold perk
changes: ♾️ Infinite gold perk (owner-only): purchases never deduct gold, the HUD shows ∞, and it survives prestige — toggled from the GM console

title: 🛠️ Staff tab
changes: New 🛠️ Staff tab in the main navigation for owner, admins, and moderators — opens the GM console (give stats, ban, broadcasts) in one tap; invisible to regular players

title: Enemy icons fixed
changes: Every enemy now has its own matching icon (Frost Wisp 👻, Stone Sentinel 🗿, dragons 🐉…) instead of a random one

title: Admin & Mod badges
changes: New 🛡️ Admin and 🔨 Mod badges — shown next to names on the leaderboard and profile
Moderator role pill now has its own styled badge in the HUD and profile
Desktop revamp: sidebar navigation, two-column battle layout, richer HUD — plus a smoother motion pass everywhere (Modern theme) and light mobile refinements

title: 10 new titles
changes: 10 new hero titles: prestige titles (the Reborn, the Phoenix, the Immortal), boss titles (the Executioner, the Godslayer), gold titles (the Hoarder, the Magnate — lifetime gold earned is now tracked), and raid titles (the Raider, the Stormcaller, the Tidebreaker)

title: Voidwalker & Dragonscale gear sets
changes: New Voidwalker Regalia gear set (dodge/crit themed, purple-black aura) — grantable from the GM console
New Dragonscale Aegis gear set (HP/regen themed, red-gold aura) — grantable from the GM console

title: New titles, raid mode & guilds
changes: 9 new hero titles: playtime titles (the Sleepless, the Tireless, the Eternal), stage titles (the Climber, the Ascendant, the Mythical) and kill titles (the Slayer, the Butcher, the Annihilator)
The latest server broadcast is now publicly readable so the client can show announcements
Raid mode: endless PvE waves with boss waves every 5, best-wave record survives prestige
Guilds: create, join, leave, and view your guild roster from the More tab
Reskinned login screen with dark-fantasy styling

title: Moderator role & GM commands
changes: New moderator staff role with broadcast and player-lookup tools
New GM commands: unlock titles, set stage, ban/unban with login enforcement, server-wide broadcasts, player list search, and full save reset

title: Leaderboard badges & flags, number fixes
changes: Fixed companion damage numbers showing "false60" — crits now display properly
Floating damage numbers now pop, rise and fade smoothly
Creator badges: YouTuber, Streamer and VIP badges shown next to names on the leaderboard
Country flags: pick your country in Profile and its flag appears on the leaderboard
New live damage meter: per-fighter DPS bars that update every second
Party overhaul: member cards with portraits, roles and live HP bars
Hero titles: unlock feats like Bossbane and the Idle King, shown on your profile and the leaderboard
Owner gear: the Sovereign Founder's Regalia now shimmers with a rainbow aura
New share button — brag your stats or grab the link for your videos
New "What's New" update log (this panel!) with dates for every patch

changes.text: GM console: more commands — grant titles, set stage, heal, reset player, grant XP

changes: Maintenance notices: players now see a proper maintenance screen and banner when the server is down for updates
title: UI 2.0 — damage meter, party cards & titles

changes: Fixed progression walling at boss stages (lower enemy HP/attack scaling)
Clicker mode now auto-attacks at 35% speed while idle — taps stay king
Mercy rule: dying 3× to the same boss retreats you 5 stages to farm
Boss popup now shows once per boss stage, death gold loss cut to 2%
Cheaper upgrades, richer XP and gold, stronger level gains
title: Balance patch — the boss-loop repair

changes: Staff-only GM console: grants, gift codes and roster management
Owner-only Sovereign Founder's Regalia, GM Fateweaver Regalia, Admin Warden Arsenal
Gift codes: create redeemable codes for full gear sets
title: GM console & privileged gear

changes: Tap combo meter with FRENZY mode (double tap damage for 10s)
Mastery talents: spend points earned every 10 levels
Professions: Herb Gathering and Smithing, leveled with gold
12 achievements paying stars, 10 named zones, Well-rested XP bonus
title: Progression systems

changes: Real accounts with secure login — progress follows you across devices
Durable cloud saves (PostgreSQL) — progress never resets
True global leaderboard with power, stage and boss rankings
Three modes: idle clicker, classic auto-battle, 3-hero party dungeon
Prestige at level 70 for +25% damage & gold per rebirth
title: Server launch
